definitions: He makes a list or a series of items.
He inclines to one side; he tilts.
He enters his name or an item into a list or register.
He causes something to lean or tilt.
examples: He lists all the ingredients needed for the recipe.
When the ship hits the wave, he lists to port.
He lists his property for sale.
He lists the reasons for his decision.
He lists the ladder against the wall.
